{{Quote|Lynlee&hellip; she was a sweet girl. Wonder whatever happened to her? Hope she caught that shuttle off Malastare. Probably should've left her some credits&hellip;|Doc|<ref name="Crazy Talk" />}}
'''Lynlee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who had a brief romantic relationship with the [[Doctor/Legends|combat medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], better known as Doc. Doc ended their relationship on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], though he later regretted not giving her some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase passage on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kira Carsen]], whom Doc was traveling with, used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on him to make the medic think about his ex-girlfriends.<ref name="Crazy Talk" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lynlee was mentioned "Crazy Talk," an optional conversation with the Jedi Knight companion character Doc in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Crazy Talk" />
